install.source: published tag (public github), not the local checkout

theDefectThatWasFixed.observedAtNewPin: dispatched: answers with the file-missing repair (grant_file_unreadable), not the USAGE banner
theDefectThatWasFixed.whyNoInstrumentCaughtIt: every prior journey ran main's CLI or read the tag's manifest; neither can notice a command the tag simply does not have

liveRevocationChain.surface: the installed package in an empty directory, nothing but the published tag

signSurvivingScopeAfter.note: a FRESH transaction; re-signing the SAME message is refused 'replay' by the product, which is the correct direction

byteSizeMeasuredSeparately.method: stat on the built file, and base64-decoded length of the daemon's signed answer, in a separate daemon run

ownDeviation: the first harness run created the ledger's parent directory under the default umask and the daemon refused it with 'ledger_dir_mode' — the product was right, the harness was wrong; re-run with umask 077
limits: own host measurement, no external user, no audit, no real funds
revocation is by NAME; it does not narrow a cap
a grant removed mid-request is judged by the loader read at the START of that request
no audit trail of who revoked what; concurrent removals are not ordered beyond the read lease
the message envelope's signature path is unaffected; the transaction envelope remains legacy-only
